description: RAON Travel Lab editor contract. All samples are finite authored synthetic previews, never runtime fixtures, authentication, live API results or real bookings. Dates use an authored 2027-10-20 Asia/Seoul reference day, not the live clock.

sampleData.comment: Exact admin response shapes for catalog, candidates, inquiry list and detail. Numeric prices illustrate native option pricing, not a second price engine. No external assets, tokens or customer data.
